theorem_title: Building the complete shared bank for every occurrence and band pair
formal_statement:
theorem ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightSharedReportingBank.program_meets {lim : _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.Light.Limits} {μ : ℕ → ℤ} {fB fC : ℕ → ℤ}
    {header record base NB NC g h J K occ d : ℕ} {p shift : ℤ}
    (H : _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.SourceBandBankData.Stored μ fB fC header NB NC g h J (2*h*J) occ p shift)
    (hw : (lim.space : ℤ) ≤ lim.word) (hKpos : 0 < K)
    (hK : K ≤ _root_.ThreeSum.LightSwitchDepth.depth J+1)
    (hocc : occ+_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightBlockSourceCatalog.count h J*J ≤ header)
    (hsource : _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.SourceBandBankData.finish header NB NC g h J (2*h*J) ≤ record)
    (hslab : record+5*K*_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.SharedReportingBankRows.total h J NB NC g ≤ base)
    (hspace : _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.SharedReportingBankRows.rowBase base h J K (_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.SharedReportingBankRows.total h J NB NC g) ≤ lim.space)
    (hword : (_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightSharedReportingBank.controlWord h J K NB NC g : ℤ) ≤ lim.word)
    (R : ∀ q < _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.SharedReportingBankRows.total h J NB NC g,
      _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightSharedReportingLevels.Resources lim (_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.SharedReportingBankRows.rowBase base h J K q) h J K g g (d+2)) :
    _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.Light.Meets lim _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightSharedReportingBank.program 66 d
      [h,J,K,_root_.ThreeSum.SourceBandBankData.first header,_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.SourceBandBankLayout.span h J (2*h*J),
        _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightBlockSourceCatalog.count h J,_root_.ThreeSum.BandPartition.size NB g,_root_.ThreeSum.BandPartition.size NC g,
        _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.SharedReportingBankLayout.localChoose h,_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.SharedReportingBankLayout.localPairs h,record,base] μ (_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightSharedReportingBank.time h J K NB NC g)
      (fun result ν => result=(_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.SharedReportingBankRows.rowBase base h J K (_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.SharedReportingBankRows.total h J NB NC g) : ℤ) ∧
        _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.SharedReportingBankRows.Done ν record base h J K NB NC g (_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.SharedReportingBankRows.total h J NB NC g) fB fC p shift ∧
        _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.Light.Kept μ ν record ∧ _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.Light.KeptBut μ ν base record (5*K*_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.SharedReportingBankRows.total h J NB NC g)) := by sorry
natural_language_statement:
Let original source-bank data for $f_B,f_C$ and lengths $N_B,N_C$ be retained, with a complete occurrence table. Take positive $K$ within the switch-depth bound plus one. Suppose all source storage precedes the level-record slab, the $5K$ records per physical bank row precede payload, and the exact endpoint, control-word, and per-row resource bounds hold. Procedure 66 constructs every row indexed by occurrence and independent source-band pair, returns the exact final row base, and preserves memory before the records and outside the designated slab below payload.

This bank constructor covers every occurrence and independent band pair with explicit record and payload allocation.
